title: NodeJs Backend Developer (Typescript, AWS)
description:
**Job Description** 



* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and RESTful APIs using Node.js and TypeScript.
* Build reliable, secure, highly available microservice\-based and distributed applications.
* Design and implement efficient data models and access patterns with Amazon DynamoDB.
* Develop cloud\-native, event\-driven backend solutions using AWS services (ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch).
* Create asynchronous workflows, background jobs, integrations, and messaging architectures.
* Define backend architecture, service boundaries, APIs, data flows, and component relationships.
* Troubleshoot complex customer\-facing and production issues.
* Address performance, scalability, stability, security, availability, and extensibility proactively.
* Participate in architecture discussions, technical design, and code reviews.
* Ensure backend services meet standards for performance, reliability, security, maintainability, and quality.
* Write automated unit, integration, API, and service\-level tests.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production using logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and alerts.
* Maintain high availability and ownership of customer trust and production reliability.
* Support and improve CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, containerization, and deployment.
* Collaborate with product managers, quality engineers, architects, and distributed teams.
* Work in Agile/Scrum environment.
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of backend features throughout the software lifecycle.
* Mentor engineers and contribute to backend engineering standards and architecture guidelines.



  





**Requirements** 




**Must\-have:** 



* 7\-9 years software engineering experience, 5\+ years backend development.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Node.js, TypeScript, JavaScript.
* Experience designing RESTful APIs, microservices, distributed backend systems.
* Proficiency with Amazon DynamoDB (partition/sort keys, indexes, query patterns).
* Experience with AWS services: ECS, Lambda, S3, SQS, API Gateway, CloudWatch.
* Experience with asynchronous, queue\-based, event\-driven workflows.
* Automated testing frameworks (Jest, Mocha, or equivalent).
* Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Jenkins or equivalent.
* Git\-based source control.
* Strong understanding of monitoring, debugging, observability, incident troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of API security, authentication/authorization, error handling, resiliency, performance optimization.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.



**Nice\-to\-have:** 



* Java, Spring Boot, React, HTML, CSS, modern JavaScript frontend.
* MySQL or PostgreSQL, Redis or Amazon ElastiCache.
* AWS Step Functions, SNS, EventBridge, IAM, EC2\.
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, AWS CDK, CloudFormation).
* Kubernetes.
* NestJS or Express.js.
* Observability tools like OpenTelemetry, Dynatrace, Datadog.
* Experience with messaging, event streaming, or distributed workflow platforms.

title: Software Development Engineer III (Java Backend)
description:
At SIXT, we are engineering the future of mobility — one system at a time. As a Senior Backend Engineer in our BranchOps team, you will engineer the systems that power the full vehicle turnaround lifecycle and branch\-level fleet orchestration, with deep integration into our IoT\-connected fleet infrastructure. This is a role where backend engineering meets real\-world operations at scale, in a team that builds with purpose and moves with pace. If this sounds like your next move, apply now and become part of something bigger.
   

  

**YOUR ROLE AT SIXT**
* You will design and build robust backend services in Java that power vehicle turnaround and fleet orchestration workflows
* You will contribute to the design and evolution of distributed, event\-driven systems that operate at branch level and at global scale
* You will develop and maintain shared libraries and internal tooling that improve reliability and delivery speed across the BranchOps engineering team
* You will collaborate closely with product, operations, and engineering stakeholders to translate complex business workflows into scalable technical solutions
* You will actively integrate AI coding tools such as Claude and Cursor into your daily development workflow, helping to embed AI\-assisted engineering as a standard practice within the team


**YOUR SKILLS MATTER**
* You hold a B.Tech, B.E., or Master's Degree in Computer Science or a closely related discipline
* You bring 7–9 years of hands\-on experience in sophisticated engineering environments — including cloud\-native application development, scalability problem\-solving, and event\-driven system design, ideally within a start\-up or scale\-up setting
* You have strong, production\-proven experience with Java and Spring Boot (must\-have) and are confident navigating a modern microservices landscape end to end
* You have designed or operated distributed systems and microservices architectures, with a clear understanding of the trade\-offs that come with operating at scale
* You have a solid grasp of event\-driven patterns, pub\-sub models, and message brokers such as Apache Kafka
* You actively use AI coding assistants — such as Cursor, Claude— to accelerate your work, while confidently recognising their limitations and knowing when engineering judgment must take precedence


**WHAT WE OFFER**
* **Grow Further, Go Further** 
 Advance your skills and unlock your potential with our Education Assistance Program
* **Balance Your Career** 
 Benefit from a hybrid work environment complemented by flexible working hours
* **Fuel Your Day** 
 Great work deserves great fuel. Enjoy meal benefits that keep you energized and ready to bring your A\-game
* **Your Wellness Matters** 
 We're committed to your well\-being through comprehensive insurance, wellness programs, health checkups, and fitness benefits
* **Recognition That Counts** 
 We create a culture of appreciation, rewarding your impact through referral incentives and loyalty perks as you advance with us
* **Growing Families, Growing Joy** 
 As your family grows, we're here to celebrate with a special newborn gift for your little one


**About us:**
 We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4\.00 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT\+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 350,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 110 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top\-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long\-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

title: Software Development Engineer, Tax Engine Services
description:
**Description**
 You'll work on one of the world's largest transactional distributed systems, solving complex tax calculation challenges that impact millions of customers globally. Join a team building mission\-critical services that process millions of requests per minute while maintaining accuracy and compliance across constantly evolving global tax regulations.
   

  

 Imagine building systems that power tax calculations for every Amazon transaction worldwide—from physical goods to digital services. In this role, you'll tackle the intricate challenge of computing correct tax amounts thousands of times per second while ensuring audit compliance across dozens of countries. You'll collaborate with peers across Amazon's business to design and operate highly scalable, reliable systems that handle hundreds of millions of records. Whether you're drawn to solving complex distributed systems problems or using technology to address real business challenges, this is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on a platform that touches billions of transactions annually.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design and implement scalable software solutions that calculate taxes accurately and efficiently across Amazon's global operations, handling millions of service requests per minute
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions that meet tax compliance standards worldwide
* Develop, test, and deploy high\-quality distributed system software using software engineering best practices and modern development methodologies
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design reviews, code reviews, documentation, testing, and operational support of production systems
* Contribute to system reliability and performance by monitoring production metrics, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing improvements to ensure our services meet demanding scale and accuracy requirements


 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you'll engage with the full software development lifecycle—from initial design conversations through deployment and operations. You might start your day reviewing a proposal to optimize tax calculation performance, then move into code review with teammates, discussing architectural approaches to handle increased transaction volume. You'll write and test code in our Java, Linux, and Oracle\-based environment, collaborate with engineers across different Amazon business units to understand their tax requirements, and participate in on\-call rotations to ensure our services remain reliable. Your work directly influences how quickly and accurately customers receive tax information at checkout, and you'll see the real\-world impact of your contributions through our monitoring and metrics.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are a group of engineers committed to building and maintaining the tax platform that serves as the backbone for tax compliance across Amazon's global operations. Our team values technical depth, collaborative problem\-solving, and a shared commitment to operational excellence. We work closely with business stakeholders, finance teams, and engineers across Amazon to understand evolving tax requirements and translate them into scalable solutions. We're focused on staying ahead of complex, ever\-changing global tax regulations while continuously improving system performance and reliability. When you join us, you'll work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about distributed systems, take ownership of their work, and support one another in solving challenging problems. We're building the future of tax technology at scale, and we're excited to have you contribute your skills and perspective to this mission.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. description:

title: Integration Engineer
description:
ComplyDP is a DPDP Act compliance platform. Live, revenue\-generating,
 



 backed by NVIDIA Inception, Google Cloud for Startups and T\-Hub.
 



  





 We are hiring founding engineers to own the data\-discovery connectors
 



 that run in our cloud, in a customer VPC, and on\-prem inside regulated
 



 networks.
 



  





 Bengaluru\-based, hybrid. Expect periodic travel to client sites, mostly
 



 Mumbai, and Delhi for deployment work.
 



  





 THE CONSTRAINT IS THE INTERESTING PART
 



  





 Our connectors describe what a customer's systems hold — schemas,
 



 columns, metadata — without reading values. No row samples, no cell
 



 contents, nothing that could carry personal data back out. That refusal
 



 is enforced by guards in the pipeline, not by convention, and it is the
 



 reason a bank will let us inside their perimeter at all.
 



  





 The other half of the job is real deployment. Our product runs inside
 



 regulated clients' infrastructure: jump hosts, change tickets, security
 



 reviews, air\-gapped installs, read replicas, service accounts scoped to
 



 the week. You will be the person who makes a connector work on someone
 



 else's network, on their terms.
 



  





 WHAT YOU WILL DO
 



  





 \- Build, test and deploy connectors across cloud SaaS, enterprise APIs
 



  and on\-prem databases
 



 \- Implement REST integrations with OAuth, pagination, retries and rate
 



  limits, and report honestly when a walk stopped early rather than
 



  claiming it finished
 



 \- Package connectors with Docker so the same job runs in our cloud, a
 



  customer VPC, or fully air\-gapped
 



 \- Write automated tests for auth, pagination, partial failure and rate
 



  limits, and ship them through CI
 



 \- Leave logs and failure modes that explain a broken sync without
 



  opening a production shell, because on a client site you often cannot
 



  





 WHAT YOU BRING
 



 \- This is connector and deployment work, not data pipeline engineering.
 



  If your experience is Spark, Databricks, ADF or warehouse ETL, it is
 



  probably not the right fit.
 



 \- 3–7 years building integrations or connectors, in Python or Java
 



 \- REST APIs, OAuth, SQL and Docker, used on systems you shipped
 



 \- Production connectors in both a cloud environment and an on\-prem or
 



  VPC environment
 



 \- Automated tests and a CI path you have used to deploy an integration
 



  change
 



 \- Comfort reading an unfamiliar schema and working out what it holds
 



 \- Willingness to travel to client sites for deployment
 



  





 BONUS
 



  





 \- Data classification, DLP, or a discovery scanner you operated in
 



  production
 



 \- Packaging an on\-prem agent, or running connectors on Kubernetes
 



 \- BFSI exposure: core banking, lending, wealth or insurance systems
 



 \- Privacy, consent or data\-governance products
 



  





 WEAKER FIT
 



 \- Primarily data pipeline / ETL engineering, ML research, frontend,
 



  analytics or BI
 



 \- Primarily ML research, frontend, analytics or BI
 



 \- DevOps or platform work without substantial connector and API
 



  development
 



 \- Work that is mostly configuring an iPaaS rather than building
 



  connectors
 



  





 We hire people who have written integrations and debugged them in
 



 production. Configuring an integration platform, without building the
 



 connector underneath, is a weaker fit.
 



  





 Founding role. Direct work with the founders, no layers.
 



 ₹18–32L plus ESOP, depending on depth.
 



  





 TO APPLY
 



  





 Email your CV to privacy@complydp.com with one paragraph: describe a
 



 connector you built, what broke in production, how you found out, and
 



 what you changed so it could not happen silently again.
 



  





 We read that paragraph before the CV.

title: Backend Engineer (Hospital Management Systems)
description:
**We're Hiring: Backend Engineer (HMS)** 
 – MedOrbit, an AI\-Native Hospital Platform
 



  





 This isn't a "maintain a CRUD app" role. MedOrbit is already live with paying hospitals, runs the full clinical and operational spine of a hospital, and has 11 AI agents in production under clinician control. You'll build the backend that doctors, nurses, lab technicians, pharmacists and billing teams use every day.
 



  





**Role Details** 




 Position: Backend Engineer (Hospital Management Systems)
 



 Location: Nagarabhavi, Bangalore (On\-site, 5 days a week)
 



 Type: Full\-time
 



 Experience: 0–2 years
 



 Joining: Immediate joiners strongly preferred
 



 Mandatory: Hands\-on experience developing a Hospital Management System (HMS), EHR/EMR, LIS, pharmacy or other healthcare software (job, internship or substantial project)
 



  





**About MedOrbit** 




 MedOrbit (by AI Nexus Innovations Hub) is a multi\-tenant hospital management platform built for Indian healthcare. One codebase serves 24 facility types, from a solo doctor's clinic to a 500\-bed super\-specialty hospital, pathology labs, imaging centres, dialysis chains, blood banks and retail pharmacies.
 



  





 It covers OPD, IPD, OT, Emergency, NICU, maternity, LIS / RIS / PACS, teleradiology, telemedicine, pharmacy, billing, revenue\-cycle management and insurance / TPA. It is ABDM\-integrated (ABHA, consent, HIP/HIU, FHIR R4\), NHCX\-connected for claims, HL7 and DICOM interoperable, and supports NABH/NABL evidence and DPDP compliance.
 



  





 What You'll Do
 



  





 1️⃣ Core HMS Modules
 



 → Build and extend Java / Spring Boot microservices across patient registration, appointments, OPD/IPD workflows, bed management, lab orders, pharmacy inventory, billing and insurance claims
 



 → Design REST APIs and database schemas that work across 24 facility types without forking the codebase
 



 → Implement module licensing and multi\-tenant data isolation so each hospital sees only what it has licensed
 



  





 2️⃣ Healthcare Integrations
 



 → Work on ABDM flows: ABHA creation/linking, consent management, HIP/HIU data exchange
 



 → Build and maintain FHIR R4 resources, HL7 messages from lab analysers, and DICOM integration with PACS
 



 → Support NHCX claim submission and TPA workflows
 



  





 3️⃣ AI Integration
 



 → Integrate Python\-based AI services (ambient scribe, lab report intelligence, X\-ray analysis, claim\-denial guard) into the core platform
 



 → Build the APIs, queues and audit trails that let AI outputs appear inside doctor workflows, with clinician approval recorded every time
 



  





 4️⃣ Reliability \& Compliance
 



 → Write unit and integration tests, review code, and fix production issues quickly
 



 → Build audit logs, role\-based access control, consent tracking and data\-erasure features for DPDP and NABH compliance
 



 → Optimise queries and APIs for hospitals with high daily patient volumes
 



  





 Tech Stack
 



 Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA, PostgreSQL / MySQL, Redis, Kafka / RabbitMQ, Python (AI services), Docker, AWS, Git, CI/CD
 



  





 What You Bring
 



  





**Must\-Have:** 




 → B.Tech / B.E. / M.Tech / MCA in Computer Science or related field (2024–2026 batches welcome)
 



 → Hands\-on experience building an HMS, EHR/EMR, LIS, RIS, pharmacy or clinic management system. Be ready to walk us through the modules you built, the database design, and the problems you solved
 



 → Strong fundamentals in Java and Spring Boot
 



 → Good understanding of REST APIs, SQL, joins, indexing and data modelling
 



 → Understanding of hospital workflows: patient registration → consultation → orders → billing → discharge
 



 → Working knowledge of Git, Docker and Linux
 



 → Clear communication – you'll work with doctors and hospital staff, not just engineers
 



  





 Nice\-to\-Have (Bonus Points!):
 



 → Exposure to FHIR, HL7, DICOM, ABDM, LOINC or ICD codes
 



 → Microservices architecture, Kafka / RabbitMQ, Redis caching
 



 → AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda) and CI/CD pipelines
 



 → Experience with insurance/TPA billing or GST\-compliant invoicing
 



 → Basic Python or experience integrating ML/LLM services
 



 → Frontend exposure (React / Angular) for full\-stack debugging
 



  





**How We Work** 




 Small team, short decision path, direct access to the founders. Specifications are written down and taken seriously. We ship continuously to a live production platform, and features are validated with real hospital users, not in a conference room.
 



  





 Why Join AI Nexus?
 



 ✅ Build a live HMS used by real hospitals from Day 1
 



 ✅ Work on India's healthcare digital stack: ABDM, FHIR, NHCX
 



 ✅ See how AI agents are built into a production hospital platform
 



 ✅ Fast\-track career growth in a high\-potential health\-tech startup
 



  





 Please Include in Your Application
 



 → Primary skills:
 



 → HMS / healthcare software experience (mandatory): modules you built, tech stack, your role; GitHub / demo link:
 



 → Total experience:
 



 → Current CTC / Expected CTC:
 



 → Notice period / How soon can you join?:
 



 → Current location:
 



 → Available for an interview this week? Preferred date and time:
 



 → On\-site role, 5 days a week, at our Nagarabhavi office (Map: https://share.google/H9bvX6kY5dka4v7Ob). Can you commute daily? Yes / No
 



  





 📩 Send your resume to: raju@thenexushub.ai
 



 🌐 https://www.ainexushub.ai/ \| https://medorbit.ai
 



  




* \#Hiring \#BackendEngineer \#Java \#SpringBoot \#Microservices \#HMS \#HospitalManagementSystem \#HealthTech \#EHR \#FHIR \#HL7 \#ABDM \#AWS \#Bangalore \#Nagarabhavi \#ImmediateJoiner \#StartupJobs

title: Alpha Nodus - Forward Deployed Engineer - Healthcare EcoSystem
description:
**About Alpha Nodus**
 Alpha Nodus builds Gravity, an AI\-powered automation platform for outpatient diagnostic imaging centers and radiology practices in the US. Gravity sits across a center's existing RIS, PACS, EHR and payer portals and takes ownership of the work a payer requires, a person has to do, and no system owns \- prior authorization, eligibility verification, document processing, scheduling and patient registration. Our engineering team is based in Bangalore, our customers are in the US, and we have been at this since 2015\.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to own the technical side of bringing new customers onto Gravity and keeping them successful after go\-live. You will sit between our customers and our product team : you scope what a new imaging center actually needs, you build the integrations and custom work that get them live, and you turn what you learn into product changes that make the next implementation easier.
   

  

 This is an engineering role, not a support or pre\-sales role. You will write production code most weeks \- integration Lambdas, HL7 and FHIR mappings, data migrations, tenant configuration \- and you will also sit on customer calls, read their workflows and explain trade\-offs to an operations director who has never seen a JSON payload. You need to be comfortable in both rooms.
   

  

 You will work from our Bangalore office on a schedule aligned to US business hours, because your customers are US imaging centers and the fastest path to a solved problem is being on the call when they are.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Discovery and implementation :
* Lead technical discovery with new customers : map their current workflow across RIS, PACS, EHR and payer portals, identify what Gravity will own, and document the integration scope.
* Own the implementation from kickoff to go\-live : tenant setup, configuration, data loads, interface testing and cutover.
* Set clear expectations with customers on scope, timeline and what "done" means, and hold both sides to them.
* Custom integrations and engineering :
* Design and build customer\-specific integrations \- HL7 over Mirth, FHIR, vendor REST APIs, SFTP feeds \- using our TypeScript, AWS and PostgreSQL stack.
* Write production\-quality code for custom work that a customer needs and the core product does not yet do, with the tests, monitoring and documentation that let someone else maintain it.
* Diagnose and fix integration and data issues end to end : read the logs, trace the message, find the line, ship the fix.
* Product feedback loop :
* Know Gravity deeply enough to solve most customer problems inside the product as it exists today \- a configuration, a workflow change, a feature they did not know they had.
* When the product falls short, write the smallest well\-scoped change that solves it, and make the case to the product team with the customer evidence behind it. Many of these you will ship yourself.
* Recognize when three customers are asking for the same custom thing and turn it into a product feature rather than a fourth custom build.
* Customer ownership :
* Act as the technical escalation point for your customers post\-go\-live; partner with customer success on anything that is not a code or configuration problem.
* Keep implementation runbooks, integration specs and tenant documentation current so the team's knowledge does not live in one head.


**Requirements**
* 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3\+ years in a customer\-facing engineering role (implementation, integration, solutions or forward deployed engineering).
* Strong backend proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js, hands\-on AWS experience (Lambda, ECS, RDS, S3, SQS/SNS), and working knowledge of PostgreSQL.
* Experience integrating with third\-party systems over APIs, message queues or file interfaces in a production setting.
* Ability to run a technical discovery conversation, write a clear scope, and explain a technical trade\-off to a non\-technical stakeholder in plain language.
* Comfort owning ambiguous problems end to end \- from "the customer says orders are not showing up" to a root cause and a shipped fix.
* Excellent written and spoken English; most of your customer communication will be written.
* Based in Bangalore, or willing to relocate, and able to work from our office on a schedule aligned to US Eastern or Central business hours.


**Nice To Have**
* Healthcare integration experience : HL7 v2, FHIR, Mirth Connect, or working with a RIS, PACS, EHR or practice management system.
* Familiarity with US healthcare workflows \- prior authorization, eligibility, scheduling, medical necessity, claims \- or a strong desire to learn them fast.
* Experience with event\-driven and serverless architectures (CQRS, SNS/SQS fan\-out).
* Experience building or operating LLM\-based features in production, including MCP.


**What This Role Is Not**
* Not an AI research or prompt\-engineering role. Gravity uses AI heavily, but your job is getting real imaging centers live and successful on it.
* Not pre\-sales. You will not carry a quota or run demos for prospects; you start work once a customer has signed.
* Not tier\-1 support. You are the escalation point, and you fix the root cause rather than the ticket.


**Why Join Alpha Nodus**
* You will see the direct result of your work : a center that was faxing prior authorizations on Monday is running them through Gravity by the end of the month, and you got them there.
* You will own customers and problems end to end, with real authority to change the product when it is the right answer.
* You will work with a small, senior team in Bangalore, alongside colleagues in the US, in a company that has been building in this domain for over a decade.
* You will build depth in US healthcare interoperability \- HL7, FHIR, payer systems, RIS/PACS/EHR integrations \- which is a scarce and durable skill set.

title: Founding Engineer
description:
**Founding Engineer** 




  





**About Comply Ark** 




 Comply Ark is a product company building regulatory infrastructure for data protection, starting with India's DPDPA. No client projects, no outsourced development, no staff augmentation. We build and own two products: DataLens, an enterprise platform for complying with the DPDPA, and CookieGate, a cookie and tracker consent platform for India and the major global privacy laws. The core architecture of DataLens is patent\-pending. Comply Ark was founded by a former data protection lawyer and a software architect, and is incubated at ISB DLabs and IIIT Hyderabad.
 



  





**The Product** 




 Most privacy tools need access to the very data they are meant to protect. DataLens does not. It is deployed inside the customer's infrastructure, where it finds and classifies personal data across databases, file stores and employee devices, including documents in Indian languages, and only opaque identifiers and metadata ever reach our cloud. That is why banks, hospitals and other regulated enterprises can adopt it. The discovery engine is built and approaching its first release. You will build the layer that turns discovery into compliance: consent, individual rights requests, breach management, retention and audit.
 



  





**How We Build** 




 We work spec\-first and build AI\-first. Every feature starts as a specification: the requirement, the edge cases, the data it may and may not touch, and the tests that prove it works. AI coding assistants write most of the implementation. Engineers own everything around it: the specification, the review, the tests and the decision to ship.
 



 Typing speed matters very little here. What matters is whether you can write a specification that cannot be misread, and whether you can look at code that compiles and passes its tests and still see that it is wrong.
 



  





**What You Will Do** 



* Turn product and legal requirements into precise technical specifications, working directly with the founders
* Break specifications into well\-scoped tasks, direct the AI tools that implement them, and review every change before it merges
* Define what "correct" means for each feature before code is written, and own the tests that prove it
* Build DataLens end to end, from the software that runs inside customer environments to our cloud application
* Guard the data\-blind boundary in every review, including the easy\-to\-miss paths such as logs, error payloads and telemetry
* Support customer deployments and diagnose problems that only appear on real infrastructure



  





**The Problems You Will Solve** 



* Resolving one person across many systems using only opaque identifiers
* Proving that an erasure request reached every copy of the data
* Keeping consent records correct through change and withdrawal
* Building audit trails that stand up to a regulator
* Running software inside locked\-down customer networks you cannot log in to
* Keeping detection fast and accurate across millions of records



  





**What We Are Looking For**

title: Principal Backend and Product Engineer
description:
**About the Company:** 





 Redesign Health
 
 is a global venture and applied technology firm focused on building next\-generation healthcare companies. We manage venture capital and venture buyout strategies, each powered by an AI operating system and a team of leading technologists, entrepreneurs, and investors drawn from the most consequential healthcare, AI, and software institutions in the world.
 



 Since 2018, Redesign and our portfolio companies have touched the lives of more than 15 million patients, raised over $1\.5 billion from premier institutional, sovereign, and strategic investors, and built distinctive partnerships with marquee healthcare organizations and senior leaders around the world. We are headquartered in New York, with offices in Bengaluru, Los Angeles, and Riyadh.
 



  





**About the Job:** 




 We're hiring a Principal Engineer to own the backend and internal platform layer between Redesign’s infrastructure and its applied AI products. This is the technology that makes our data, tools, and development patterns usable by engineers, agents, and the domain experts building software across the firm.
 



  





 One distinctive feature of Redesign is that every person at the company is, in some meaningful sense, a software engineer. Building for that audience is a new and special craft: the platform has to be powerful enough for senior engineers, legible enough for nontraditional builders, and structured enough for agents to use safely.
 



  





 You will report to a VP of Technology, and join a global technology practice built around senior individual contributors with unusually broad ownership. In this role, you will own a full technical domain between infrastructure and applied AI, and build it around agentic principles.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 




 At Redesign, everyone builds. Experienced engineers ship more complexity than ever before, domain experts turn judgment into working systems, and agents participate in the path from idea to production. That changes what backend engineering means. The backend is the shared layer of data, access, tools, and conventions that lets many kinds of builders create safely. This role owns that layer between infrastructure and applied AI.
 


* *Build the backend platform behind Redesign’s operating system.* 
 You will own the APIs, databases, services, resource models, migrations, and access patterns that back our core AI operating system. Your job is to make the primitives behind Redesign’s work easy to discover, safe to extend, and hard to misuse, so applications, agents, and builders can consume trusted data without bespoke plumbing.
* *Define the paradigm for AI\-native development.* 
 You will own the systems and conventions that let agents drive software engineering: agentic coding patterns, harness design, memory management, verification loops, and self\-learning multi\-agent code review. Done well, this unlocks a trusted path from intent to production: if generated code is safe, standards\-compliant, and proven to do what it was meant to do, it can become part of the system without turning human review into a bottleneck.
* *Build for a workforce where everyone creates software.* 
 You will own the developer experience for a builder population that brings together infrastructure engineers, applied AI engineers, and domain experts without formal software backgrounds. You will deeply understand how Redesign functions and build powerful primitives that cut across teams, decisions, and geographies. That means thoughtfully designed tools and interfaces that capture the most important work and workflows, and let the whole firm turn judgment into technology at the speed of thought.



  





**What You'll Need:** 




 We value and actively seek exceptional talent from all backgrounds and experiences, recognizing that excellence takes many forms. The strongest candidates have been selected into high\-talent environments, distinguished themselves within them, earned unusually broad scope or trusted ownership, progressed rapidly, or done work that changed the trajectory of a team, product, company, or field. While every path is different, we believe the most successful candidates for this role will share the following characteristics:
 


* 10\-12\+ years of engineering experience, with meaningful time at staff, principal, or equivalent level at a serious software company. You have anchored the technical work of a small, fast team before, and you have owned backend, data, developer\-platform, or internal\-platform systems that other people built on every day.
* You have shipped production backend systems in Python and/or TypeScript, with ownership of database schemas, migrations, API contracts, authentication, and permissions. You have worked deeply with Postgres or a similar relational database; built authorization or identity layers with scoped access for users, services, and agents; and shipped APIs and data services that multiple teams depended on.
* You have built or operated agent\-facing infrastructure that teams used every day: MCP servers and tools, Claude Code or Cursor conventions, skills or plugin systems, sandboxed execution, code\-review automation, evals, usage and cost controls, and safe defaults. You understand that agents are now first\-class consumers of backend systems.
* You have range across product craft and developer experience. You have built tools, applications, or internal platforms for experienced engineers and for builders without traditional software backgrounds, and you understand that this work is as much about shaping how people encounter the system as it is about creating a technical surface. You have thought deeply about how different kinds of builders climb the AI curve, where they get stuck, and what a great first experience should feel like.
* You are AI\-native. LLMs and agents have rewired how you build. You are proficient with modern agent frameworks (the Anthropic Agent SDK, Lang\* / Deep Agents, or similar) and have shipped production systems on top of them. You have built sophisticated systems on top of coding agents like Claude Code (skills, MCPs, custom harnesses) and have hardly written code by hand in over a year.
* Technology is one of your passions, and you find deep meaning in some other pursuit to which you've devoted your time, thought, and effort: a creative or athletic outlet, a family business, or service.



**Strong plus:** 
 track record as a founder, founding engineer, or 0\-to\-1 product engineering owner inside a small, fast team.
 



**Bonus:** 
 a quantitative degree (or a few) from a strong program; open\-source contributions; published work; or a side project other people have actually used.
 



  





 Who You Are:
 


* A true builder who is always tinkering, experimenting, and looking for the better way. Where others see one\-off app requests, you see the workflows, access patterns, and primitives that could make the next ten requests easier.
* Proud of platform craft. You believe the difference between systems people build on and systems people work around is the quality of the design, and the technical and business judgment behind it.
* A clear writer who believes English is the most important programming language. Your API docs, migration notes, examples, agent instructions, and tool descriptions make the right path obvious to humans and agents.
* Allergic to repeating yourself. If you see the same workaround twice, the third answer is a shared service, MCP tool, template, or platform capability.
* Deeply curious about the business, not just the technology. You can read a deal memo, a fundraising deck, and a research note and create great data models, APIs, and tools around them.
* You design for agents as first\-class users. You think about tools, context, permissions, evals, memory, and failure recovery as product surfaces.
* You have thrived in a group of passionate, talented, diverse, and low\-ego individuals because these kinds of people love working with you.
* You have accomplished something most people haven't: started a company, won an international academic award, shipped a product loved by many, performed music around the world, or overcome difficult circumstances to succeed. You have dedicated your life to excellence in your craft.



  





**How We Work:** 




 Our company values are the standards and norms that shape how we make decisions, build teams, serve patients, and partner with one another. They define what you can expect from us and what we expect from every person who joins our team. We share them openly so candidates can decide whether this way of working will bring out their best.
 


* **Patients are waiting:** 
 Work with the urgency that patients deserve.
* **AI sets the floor:** 
 Nothing short of what AI in expert hands can deliver; taste and judgment own the last mile.
* **Stack the team:** 
 Talent density is our greatest asset; raise the bar with every hire.
* **Trust people, challenge ideas:** 
 Assume good intent; never shy from rigorous debate.
* **Sweat your craft:** 
 Take pride in your work; seek feedback to continuously improve.
* **Go beyond:** 
 Your role, comfort zone, and expectations for what’s possible.
* **Be the partner you want:** 
 High integrity, responsive, and genuinely invested in shared success.
* **No shortcuts:** 
 Patient safety, clinical standards, and partner trust above all.



  





**Compensation and Location:** 




 You will work out of our Bengaluru office on a hybrid schedule, with strong overlap into US Eastern and Pacific hours.. We target world\-class talent and compensate accordingly, with packages containing a mix of cash and fund equity.

**Nice to Have:**

 As Principal Software Development Engineering at Tesco, I am responsible for driving the technical strategy and design of Identity and Access Management solutions, which underpins the security and the overall defence capability of Tesco. This includes technology leadership for a team of Developers and System Engineers, covering software and system development of IAM technologies, systems and tools related to identity lifecycle, identity \& Access governance, privileged access management, and overall access management.
 



 I work in an agile manner, responding to the changing threat landscape, and working closely with Product Management and Identity Security Controls teams to ensure that what we are designing and developing is optimal in terms of scalability, availability, operability, cost and usability.
 



 I am seasoned Architect and have great understanding and knowledge of Cyber Security practices, and dynamic professional, will efficiently collaborating with other stakeholders like Workplace and System Infra, Network and Cloud Platform teams.
 



  





 In this job, I am accountable for:
 



 Following our Business Code of Conduct and always acting with integrity and due diligence and have these specific risk responsibilities:
 


* System Performance and Scale
* Technical barrier to execution
* Adoption of latest technologies
* Help product in proof of concepts and technologies evaluation
* Upskilling and mentoring the team members



  





 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Principal Software Development Engineer to technically lead our Identity and Access Management (IAM) team and serve as a leader with vision in this space. The ideal candidate will have an understanding of Product Development, Infrastructure and IAM technologies, strong leadership skills, and a consistent record of implementing secure and scalable IAM solutions. This role requires close collaboration with the IAM operations team and product management to ensure the integrity and security of our systems and data.
 



  




* Spearhead a highly skilled IAM engineering team, providing mentorship and guidance to ensure high performance and top notch development team and systems.
* Develop and implement IAM Platforms strategies, architectures, and roadmaps aligned with business objectives and security requirements.
* Lead the design, development, and deployment of complex IAM solutions, including authentication, authorization, identity governance, and access controls.
* Build and maintain robust IAM platforms to modern engineering excellence practices, ensuring scalability and resilience to meet the needs of Tesco.
* Own the issues/barriers in the rollout of new solutions, and get them closed with technical expertise and required collaboration.
* Partner with the Product Management team to align IAM solutions with business needs and user requirements.
* Collaborate with the IAM Security Controls team to understand and resolve the painpoints in their BAU tasks.
* Monitor and evaluate emerging IAM and product development technologies and trends, making recommendations for adoption where appropriate.
* Engage with existing / new vendors and third party IAM solutions to ensure effective implementation and support.
* Drive continuous improvement of IAM processes, tools, and practices to enhance security, user experience, and operational efficiency.
* Respond to security incidents related to identity and access management and lead efforts to resolve them promptly and effectively.
* Influence the technology direction of the organisation towards adopting zero trust and identity based authentication frameworks.
* Mentor team of developers and system engineering in terms of technical skills and practices.



  





 Operational skills relevant for this job:
 


* Strong written, verbal communication and presentation skills
* Deep technical and engineering skills, such as from a background in system administration or software engineering
* Growth mindset – believes in continuous improvement and change to the system and processes


- 


 Experience relevant for this job:
 



 Required Skills and Qualifications:
 


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field. Advanced degree preferred.
* 12\+ years of experience in IT and full stack Software development, with at least 5 years in technically leading a team, ideally within Security space.
* Strong software development background (preferably with Java, React.js, Postgress, Kafka, Azure Cloud services) with experience in architecture, designing and building inhouse solutions, preferably IAM systems
* Experience of implementing and improvising DevOps practices for in\-house and cloud platforms
* Understanding of IAM concepts and technologies, including Vaulting, SSO, MFA, LDAP, OAuth, SAML, and identity governance.
* Experience of building/leveraging LLM for product development and processes automations
* Demonstrable experience in building and maintaining IAM or similar platforms in complex, large scale environments.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to make sound decisions under pressure.
* Great understanding or IT infrastructure components such as network perimeter, domain controllers, VSphere, Kubernetes and cloud.
* Experience of mentoring a highly skilled team of developers and system engineering.
* Demonstrable experience of improving an existing system for better performance and resiliency with help of technologies and DevOps processes
* Great communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively convey complex technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders.
* Architectural understanding of zero trust and identity\-based authentication frameworks.

**Job Description**

 Company Description
   

  





 LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
   

  





 Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  





 Team:
   

  





 This role is part of LinkedIn’s Enterprise Innovation (EI) organization, where we build the next generation of products and platforms that power employee productivity, collaboration, and data experiences. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategy, architecture, governance, and evolution of LinkedIn’s Atlassian ecosystem, including Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, and related capabilities. You will help establish a scalable platform vision, define standards and operating models, and ensure these products can reliably support teams and workflows across LinkedIn at enterprise scale.
   

  





 Beyond traditional Atlassian administration, you will design and build solutions on top of the platform, including automations, integrations, APIs, workflows, and platform services that connect Atlassian products seamlessly with LinkedIn’s internal systems. You will apply strong engineering principles across reliability, security, performance, identity and access, observability, and platform governance while helping simplify fragmented processes and create scalable, self\-service experiences. You will also help explore how Atlassian, Rovo, and LinkedIn’s internal AI platforms can enable intelligent agents and AI\-first workflows that improve employee productivity and reduce manual work.
   

  





 We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Enterprise Engineer to help design the Future of Work at LinkedIn. You will bring deep experience with Jira, Confluence, and the broader Atlassian ecosystem, along with strong expertise in enterprise\-scale platform engineering, automation, integrations, governance, and vendor partnership. You should be excited to operate at the intersection of enterprise platforms, software engineering, AI, automation, and employee productivity, and to build systems and capabilities that deliver measurable impact across LinkedIn.
   

  





 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 Responsibilities
   

  




* You will own and evolve LinkedIn’s Atlassian platform strategy, including Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, and related products, with a focus on scalability, reliability, governance, and employee experience.
* You will design, configure, and optimize enterprise\-scale Atlassian environments, including projects, workflows, schemes, permissions, custom fields, automations, and platform standards.
* You will build and maintain integrations, APIs, automations, and custom capabilities that connect Atlassian products with LinkedIn’s internal systems, platforms, and engineering ecosystem.
* You will develop scalable self\-service capabilities that reduce operational overhead, simplify complex workflows, and improve productivity across engineering and business teams.
* You will apply strong software and platform engineering practices across availability, performance, observability, resiliency, capacity planning, and operational readiness that operate 24x7\.
* You will drive the adoption of AI\-first and agentic experiences, leveraging Atlassian capabilities, Rovo, APIs, and LinkedIn’s internal AI platforms to automate work and improve employee productivity.
* You will partner closely with Atlassian and other strategic vendors to influence roadmap, address product gaps, lead scrums, and ensure LinkedIn’s enterprise requirements are represented.
* You will define and track platform health, adoption, reliability, productivity, and operational metrics to measure the impact of platform investments.
* You will create reusable standards, patterns, documentation, and best practices that enable teams across LinkedIn to use Atlassian products effectively and consistently.
* You will work with product managers, program managers and dependent engineering teams to negotiate technical trade\-offs, define service boundaries, and ensure on\-time delivery.
* You will be responsible for operational tasks and on\-call support for the relevant applications and systems.
* You will learn to balance tactical day\-to\-day execution with long\-term technical debt management and strategic component roadmapping.
* You will provide technical leadership on complex platform decisions and help shape the long\-term direction of employee productivity and collaboration systems across LinkedIn.
* You will participate in the on\-call rotation for incident response and critical operational support that impacts service


**Qualifications**

 Qualifications
   

  





 Basic Qualifications
   

  




* BS (or higher, e.g., MS, or PhD) in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e.g., physics or mathematics), or equivalent technical experience.
* 5\+ years of industry experience.



 Preferred Qualifications
   

  




* Expertise with Jira, Confluence, and JSM, including workflows, schemes, permissions, custom fields, automation, governance, administration, and platform lifecycle management.
* Experience building integrations, automations, APIs, and custom applications using webhooks, REST, Forge, scripting, or general\-purpose programming languages (eg. Python).
* Expert knowledge of computer science, with strong competencies in data structures, algorithms, and software design.
* Experience with enterprise identity and access management, including SSO, SAML, SCIM, OAuth, service accounts, role\-based access controls, and security governance.
* Experience evaluating and managing Atlassian Marketplace applications, third\-party integrations, and build\-versus\-buy decisions across a complex application ecosystem.
* Experience with AI\-enabled workflows, intelligent automation, Rovo, agentic systems, or enterprise AI platforms is highly desirable.
* Proven ability to partner across engineering, security, infrastructure, product, and business teams and influence technical decisions without direct authority.
* Skills with coding in Python, Java or Go, database design and SQL, and/or knowledge of standard libraries used for building enterprise applications is a plus.
* Strong communication and technical leadership skills, with the ability to translate complex platform challenges into clear technical strategies and scalable solutions.



 Suggested Skills
   

  




* Atlassian Platform Engineering
* API Development \& Systems Integration
* Automation \& Workflow Engineering
* Enterprise Platform Architecture \& Scalability

title: Senior Platform Engineer (Backend & Infra)
description:
Our backend works. It was built by a small team moving fast, and it now needs to scale from 100 to 1,000 facilities and beyond. It also has to become safe enough to act on its own. Dosing changes, pump sequencing, and setpoints are increasingly executed by software on live plants, which means every action must be observable and every deploy reversible. This role owns that safety rail.
 



  





 You'll be our first dedicated platform hire, writing Node.js services and the Terraform they run on, and setting the standard for how infrastructure, delivery, and reliability work here.
 



 You'll inherit real systems in production (alert engine, event log, device management, edge\-to\-cloud ingestion) and a clear mandate: make them boring to operate, then make them scale 50x.
 



  





  





  





**Infrastructure and delivery (core):** 




 Our AWS footprint as code — Terraform or CDK, no more click\-ops — with environments that are reproducible and provably identical
 



 CI/CD from commit to production: build, test gates, staged rollout, and rollback
 



 Containers, orchestration, and the deployment story for services and edge components alike
 



 Secrets, IAM, network boundaries, and a cloud bill that is measured and managed line by line
 



  





**Backend services (with the team):** 




 Node.js/TypeScript services and APIs alongside other backend engineers; you review their PRs and they review yours
 



 The edge\-to\-cloud ingestion path: MQTT at fleet scale, buffering, replay, backpressure, and what happens when a plant's link drops for six hours
 



 The alert and event systems that decide what a plant operator sees, and what wakes someone up
 



 The action path: how a recommendation from our intelligence stack becomes a verified, reversible command on a plant, with guardrails at every hop
 



 Contracts between edge, cloud, and our intelligence stack: agreed before build, versioned, enforced
 



 Cloud and edge deployment workflows, including deployment of sensor configuration files across a fleet of edge devices currently managing \~35,000 sensors
 



  





**Reliability and operations:** 




 Observability as a product surface, not an afterthought: metrics, traces, and logs that answer "is the fleet healthy?" immediately
 



 SLOs on the paths that matter, alerts that fire on symptoms rather than noise, and an on\-call rotation you'll help design so it stays humane as the fleet grows
 



 Incident response and blameless postmortems that actually change the code
 



 Load and failure testing against 50x device volume before the contract lands, not after
 



  





**Elevating how we ship:** 




 Test coverage and CI gates on all of our services
 



 Runbooks and architecture notes that let anyone on the team operate what you build
 



 Paved paths: the easy way to add a service should also be the correct way
 



 KPI Expectations
 



  





  





**This role is not for you if:\-** 




 You're looking for a greenfield stack. This is real code with real history, and the job is making it excellent.
 



 You want to stay purely on infrastructure and never touch product code, or purely on product and never be accountable for it in production
 



 You'd rather move fast now and add tests later
 



 You're not curious about how a wastewater plant actually works. You'll be visiting one in your first month.

description:

 As an
 **AI Customer Engineer** 
 , you will make an impact by
 **building scalable AI agent solutions and accelerating enterprise adoption of Generative AI technologies** 
 . You will be a valued member of the
 **AI Engineering team** 
 and work collaboratively with
 **architects, product teams, and cross\-functional stakeholders** 
 to deliver intelligent, production\-grade AI applications.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Build and deploy AI agents and GenAI\-powered applications using modern frameworks and platforms
* Design and implement RAG pipelines, prompt engineering workflows, and LLM integrations
* Develop scalable backend services and APIs for AI\-driven systems
* Enable cloud\-native deployments with containerization and microservices architecture
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver reliable, secure, and high\-performing AI solutions


**Work model: Work from Office**
 At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is an
 **onsite position requiring 5 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in \[Chennai/Bangalore]**

 The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.

title: Staff Engineer - Open Source Committer and Contributor | (ODP)
description:
At Acceldata, We are revolutionizing data observability in how enterprises manage and observe data by offering comprehensive solutions tailored to each organization's unique needs. Our platform integrates various technologies, enabling seamless data observability for modern enterprises.
   

  

**About the Role:** 
 We are looking for a
 **Staff Engineer (Apache Open Source Committer and** 
**Contributors** 
**)** 
 to lead the development of a data platform built on Apache open\-source technologies. In this role, you will design, implement, and optimize distributed data systems while actively contributing to the open\-source community. You will work with cross\-functional teams to address technical challenges, ensure system scalability, and improve performance. As an Apache committer, you will drive the technical direction of the project, submit patches, and review contributions to enhance functionality, security, and reliability.
   

  

 This role offers the opportunity to build cutting\-edge data solutions, influence the open\-source ecosystem, and collaborate with industry experts. Your contributions will have a lasting impact on both the data platform and the broader open\-source community.
   

  

**You are a great fit for this role if you have**
* Enthusiasm for the open\-source projects, with a focus on improving the ecosystem, driving innovation, and contributing back to the community.
* Extensive hands\-on experience in configuring storage and related components, troubleshooting complex software defects, including reproducing issues from written descriptions, using effective techniques to identify root causes, navigating large codebases, and developing both temporary workarounds and permanent solutions.
* Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, presenting technical accomplishments and strategic insights.
* Strong coding, debugging, and troubleshooting skills to resolve issues, enhance software applications, and ensure smooth deployment without introducing new problems.
* Expertise in guiding teams to implement systems and subsystems effectively, translating business requirements into actionable designs.
* Ability to quickly learn new technologies


**What We Look For**
* 9\+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 4\-5 years actively contributing to open\-source projects, ideally within the Apache ecosystem.
* Lead technical discussions within the community, define architecture improvements, and ensure code quality through reviews and mentorship.
* Deep knowledge of one or more Apache projects (e.g., Hadoop, Kafka, Spark, Hive, Flink) and their underlying architecture.
* Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Python, Scala, or Go is preferred. Experience with distributed computing and high\-performance applications is also highly preferred.
* Proven track record of making significant contributions to open\-source projects, including submitting patches, reviewing contributions, and interacting with the community.
* Strong ability to collaborate with internal teams, external contributors, and the wider open\-source community.
* Experience deploying and managing open\-source solutions in both cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) and on\-premise environments.
* Actively address bug reports, security vulnerabilities, and contribute to project maintenance, ensuring that software remains up\-to\-date with the latest standards.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Principal Software Development Engineer
description:
**About The Team**
 The Developer Experience (DevEx) Delivery Engineering team builds and operates Zillow's software delivery platform. This is the paved road from commit to production that every Zillow Group engineer relies on to build, test, deploy, and ship. The platform supports org\-wide delivery infrastructure at meaningful scale: CI/CD, runners, GitLab, Artifactory, Progressive Delivery, mobile build and release, and legacy migration programs. We are shifting from hands\-on infrastructure operations toward secure, compliant, AI\-first paved paths that improve reliability, release safety, and developer productivity.
   

  

 We are standing up a new India\-based team to expand capacity, enable follow\-the\-sun coverage, and take first\-class ownership of high\-impact platform initiatives. As one of the founding members, you'll help shape a brand\-new engineering site while working on infrastructure that multiplies the productivity of the entire engineering organization.
   

  

 What the team works on
   

  

* GitLab (including GitLab Dedicated and Duo): operate the central source\-control and CI/CD platform and enable secure, AI\-assisted SDLC workflows.
* CI/CD runners: modernize Linux, macOS, iOS, and Android runner fleets improving isolation, queueing, and cost attribution.
* Progressive Delivery: scale canary, health\-gated, rollback\-aware deployment patterns.
* Artifactory and supply chain: operate a Tier\-0 artifact platform and improve upgrade, backup, retention, and lifecycle practices.
* Migration and modernization: retire legacy CI/CD (Concrete) using dashboards, partner engagement, and agentic migration.
* Mobile build/release and Mobile DevOps: sustain a high release cadence while modernizing build tooling.


**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** 
 Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the founding Principal Engineer for the India Delivery Engineering team, you'll be the technical anchor for a brand\-new site and the most senior individual contributor on the team. You'll set the architecture for our most important platform systems, CI/CD execution, build and runner infrastructure, and GitLab/Artifactory integrations. Drive standards that other teams adopt, and turn India's ownership into durable technical authority through design reviews, reliability practices, and real deliverables from day one.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on, high\-leverage role for someone who wants to lead platform architecture and mentor a growing team while partnering closely with engineering leaders across geographies.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Set the architecture for CI/CD execution, build and runner infrastructure, GitLab/Artifactory integrations, and the paved paths all Zillow engineers use.
* Drive patterns and standards that other teams adopt, acting as design authority for India\-owned areas in partnership with senior engineers across the org.
* Take the most ambiguous components from problem framing to production\-ready, observable, well\-documented systems.
* Hire and mentor engineers, raise the quality of code and design reviews, and help set the team's engineering standards.
* Lead the safe adoption of AI across migration, code review, platform operations, incident triage, and rollout guidance.
* Shape on\-call maturity, SLOs, incident response, runbooks, and reliability practices for the team's services.
* Write clear design docs and distill complex platform tradeoffs for engineers, managers, partner teams, and executives across geographies


 This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
   

  

 In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
   

  

 Who you are
   

  

* 10\+ years of software engineering experience, with extensive experience in large\-scale CI/CD, build/runner infrastructure, cloud\-native platform engineering, developer\-productivity tooling, or SRE/platform systems.
* Deep system design and architecture judgment for scalable, reliable, maintainable systems, with strong testability, resilience, security, and observability practices.
* Technical leadership and influence without direct authority, with a proven ability to align multiple teams on standards and tradeoffs.
* Production ownership: incident response, on\-call, operational debugging, capacity planning, and post\-incident prevention.
* Strong programming fundamentals in Python, Java, Go, or similar; able to review code, debug systems, and reason about performance and concurrency.
* Hands\-on or deep conceptual experience with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, containers, CI/CD platforms, and infrastructure as code.
* Exceptional written communication: design docs, strategy docs, decision records, rollout plans, and executive\-ready tradeoff summaries.
* Comfort operating async\-first across US–India time zones and helping build a new engineering culture.


 Bonus points
   

  

* Depth in GitLab (including GitLab Dedicated and Duo), runner fleets, or Artifactory.
* Experience with SaltStack, Ansible, Puppet, or comparable automation tooling.
* Mobile build infrastructure experience (iOS or Android).
* Prior experience applying AI in the software development lifecycle.
* Experience founding or scaling a new site or distributed engineering team.


 Why join
   

  

* Founding role: shape a new India engineering site and help set the technical and cultural bar from day one.
* High leverage: work on the platform used by every Zillow engineer and every major product surface.
* Modernization agenda: GitLab Dedicated, runner rearchitecture, Progressive Delivery, Artifactory modernization, and legacy retirement.
* AI\-first work: real production use cases across code review, migrations, incident analysis, and deployment safety.
* Global collaboration: partner directly with US engineering leaders while building durable India ownership.


 Get to know us
   

  

 At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.
   

  

 As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.
   

  

 Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.
   

  

 Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.
   

  

 No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.
   

  

*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.*

**Overview**
 Job Description
   

  

 At Airbus, we are leveraging artificial intelligence to boost efficiency and quality across our value chain. Our team brings together technologists and business leaders dedicated to innovation and excellence.
   

  

 We are looking for an MLOps Engineer with 0\-2 years of experience to join our Advanced Analytics and Artificial Intelligence PSL. In this high\-growth AI team, you will help develop, maintain, and scale our centralized ModelOps platform. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, DevOps, and Machine Learning operations to keep our AI infrastructure robust while independently delivering feature enhancements.
   

  

 Collaborating with senior engineers, you will focus on improving the ModelOps platform, building MLOps deployment pipelines for both traditional Machine Learning and Generative AI models, exploring modern ML services, automating operational workflows, and developing serverless internal tools.
   

  

**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
* Experience: 0\-2 years of hands\-on experience in Software Engineering, DevOps, MLOps, and Cloud. Fresh graduates with strong project experience or internships in these areas are welcome to apply.


 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Platform Operations \& APIs: Design, build, and maintain high\-performance, serverless microservices and RESTful APIs for model inference and platform operations. Ensure high availability, reliability, and smooth day\-to\-day operations.
* CI/CD \& Pipeline Automation: Build, configure, and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (using platforms like GitHub and GitLab) with Infrastructure\-as\-Code to automate testing and deployment. Implement automated checks to prevent operational downtime.
* MLOps \& Model Management: Use native AWS AI/ML platforms to deploy, monitor, and manage the lifecycle of Machine Learning and Generative AI models. Set up basic observability for model drift, inference latency, and performance metrics.


 Technical Requirements
   

  

* Core Programming: Strong proficiency in Python and hands\-on experience with FastAPI. Basic knowledge of Vue.js (or similar modern JavaScript frameworks).
* Cloud \& Infrastructure: Solid understanding of core AWS services (Lambda, S3, SageMaker, Bedrock, IAM, ECS, API Gateway, etc.) and hands\-on experience with AWS CDK for defining infrastructure as code.
* DevOps \& Containerization: Practical experience creating and managing Docker containers, utilizing version control systems (GitHub, GitLab), and configuring deployment pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or Jenkins).
* Databases: Experience working with both relational (PostgreSQL) and NoSQL (AWS DynamoDB) databases.


 Soft Skills \& Behavioral Attributes
   

  

* Fast Learning Curve: Demonstrated ability to quickly master new technologies, tools, and frameworks.
* Adaptability \& Agility: Willingness to wear multiple hats, building an API one day and tweaking ML pipelines the next.
* Problem\-Solving Mindset: Strong logical reasoning, analytical skills, and attention to detail.
* Communication: Clear written and verbal communication skills to articulate ideas effectively within a team environment.


 Nice\-to\-Have / Added Advantages
   

  

* AWS or GCP Cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner / Developer, GCP Associate Cloud Engineer).
* Active GitHub profile, Kaggle participation, or personal projects demonstrating end\-to\-end full\-stack or computer vision implementations.
* AWS services like SageMaker and Step Functions.
